entities.summary: Robert Kurtzman is an American film director, producer, screenwriter, and special effects makeup artist. During his time at KNB EFX Group, which he co-founded, it would win a 2001 Emmy Award. He would then start his own production company Precinct 13 Entertainment in 2003 and Robert Kurtzman's Creature Corps. In 2017, Kurtzman and his partner Marcia King moved to Atlanta and formed Robert Kurtzman MUFX LLC.
